section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM - Cruise Control System
title: CONTINUED FROM PREVIOUS PAGE

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for cruise control system testing, showing four main test circuits: Set/Coast Switch, Accel/Resume Switch, Control Valve, and Release Valve. Each test has Yes/No branches leading to specific diagnostic actions.

content.title: INSPECT SET/COAST SWITCH CIRCUIT
content.test: Is there continuity between terminal 4 and body ground with set/coast switch turned on?
if_no: Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 4 of computer and terminal 30 of control switch.

content.test: Is there continuity between terminal 4 and body ground with set/coast switch turned off?
if_yes: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 4 of computer and terminal 30 of control switch.

content.title: INSPECT ACCEL/RESUME SWITCH CIRCUIT
content.test: Is there continuity between terminal 13 and body ground with accel/resume switch turned on?
if_no: Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 13 of computer and terminal 28 of control switch.

content.test: Is there continuity between terminal 13 and body ground with accel/resume switch turned off?
if_yes: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 13 of computer and terminal 28 of control switch.

content.title: INSPECT CONTROL VALVE CIRCUIT
content.test: Is resistance value about 30 Ω between terminals 2 and 3?
if_no: Open or short circuit in wire harness between terminal 3 of computer and terminal 2 of actuator.
Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 1 of actuator and terminal 2 of computer.

content.title: INSPECT RELEASE VALVE CIRCUIT
content.test: Is resistance value about 68 Ω between terminals 1 and 2 with brake pedal returned?
if_no: Open or short circuit in wire harness between terminal 1 of computer and terminal 3 of actuator.
Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 1 of actuator and terminal 2 of computer.
